title: agent_retrospective_run/v1
description: Schema for a single agent-retrospective run. A run is modeled as a bounded observation (docs/adr/0007-agent-retrospective-boundaries.md, Decision 1), NOT as a single atomic snapshot: the repository source is an immutable snapshot anchored at run_identity.base_sha, but GitHub/web/runtime sources are paginated and can change mid-collection, so each source's observation window and pagination completeness must be recorded independently in source_observations. This schema is the state primary record for a run; docs/dev/agent-retro-index.md (agent_retro_index/v1) remains a derived index only and is not a state store (ADR 0007, Decision 7).

run_identity.description: Identity of the run as a whole. base_sha anchors the repository-source immutable snapshot; source_set_digest is a deterministic digest over source_observations (see compute_source_set_digest() in validate_retrospective_schema.py) intended for idempotency use only ((repo, base_sha, source_set_digest, scope) duplicate suppression, ADR 0007 Decision 5). It is NOT an optimistic-concurrency / stale-write-protection token; that mechanism (expected_previous_digest / version) is out of scope for this schema (Child 5 / #2238 responsibility). validate_run() recomputes and cross-checks this digest against source_observations; it is not a free-form caller-supplied value.

base_sha.description: Full-length repository commit SHA the run is anchored to. Repository-source claims are treated as an immutable snapshot at this commit.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this run record was generated.

runtime_version.description: Version identifier of the agent-retrospective runtime that produced this run.

source_set_digest.description: Deterministic sha256 hex digest computed over source_observations by compute_source_set_digest(). Used for idempotency (duplicate suppression) only -- not for optimistic concurrency. validate_run() rejects any run whose stored digest does not match the recomputed value.

source_observations.description: Per-source bounded observation records. Required so a run is never mistaken for a single atomic snapshot (ADR 0007 Decision 1). One entry per Child 3 (#2236) adapter invocation (claude_code / claude_gpt / repository / github / web); source_id identifies which adapter produced the entry independently of the coarser source_type trust class.

source_type.description: Coarse trust/authority class of the source observed, used by the ADR 0007 Decision 2 claim-class source-authority table. 'repository' is treated as an immutable snapshot anchored at run_identity.base_sha (fetch_started_at/fetch_completed_at are optional for this source_type). Non-repository source_type values (github/web/runtime) are paginated / time-varying and MUST record fetch_started_at/fetch_completed_at. 'runtime' covers both the claude_code and claude_gpt adapters (#2236); source_id disambiguates which one produced this entry.

source_id.description: Identity of the specific Child 3 (#2236) adapter that produced this observation. Distinct from source_type: source_type groups claude_code and claude_gpt under the coarser 'runtime' trust class, while source_id disambiguates the two.

source_status.description: Outcome of this adapter's collection attempt, returned independently of every other source's status (Child 3 / #2236 AC2, fail-independent collection). 'blocked' covers permission/authorization failures distinct from transient 'unavailable' failures.

observed_from.description: Deprecated: superseded by fetch_started_at (acquisition window) and resource_updated_at_min (resource-event window) per ADR 0007 Decision 1 (2026-08-19 OWNER review P1-8). Retained only for backward-compatible reads of pre-ADR-0007 records; new writers MUST use the split fields instead.

observed_until.description: Deprecated: superseded by fetch_completed_at (acquisition window) and resource_updated_at_max (resource-event window) per ADR 0007 Decision 1 (2026-08-19 OWNER review P1-8). Retained only for backward-compatible reads of pre-ADR-0007 records; new writers MUST use the split fields instead.

fetch_started_at.description: Acquisition window start: wall-clock time this source's API collection began (ADR 0007 Decision 1, distinct from resource_updated_at_min/max). Required for all non-repository source_type values.

fetch_completed_at.description: Acquisition window end: wall-clock time this source's API collection completed. Required for all non-repository source_type values.

resource_updated_at_min.description: Resource-event window minimum: earliest last-updated timestamp among the collected resources.

resource_updated_at_max.description: Resource-event window maximum: latest last-updated timestamp among the collected resources.

pagination_completeness.description: Whether pagination traversal for this source completed. 'partial' MUST be accompanied by partial_reason (enforced by the allOf/if/then invariant above, not description text alone).

partial_reason.description: Reason pagination was cut short (e.g. rate_limit, timeout). Required when pagination_completeness is 'partial' (schema-enforced).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor / continuation token, when available, for reproducibility and diffing.

etag.description: ETag or equivalent identity metadata for change detection, when available.

endpoint.description: API endpoint queried for this source.

api_version.description: API version used for this source's collection.

query_params.description: Filter / query parameters applied when collecting this source.

page_size.description: Page size used for this source's collection.
